description: This file provides functions to manage SSH sandbox sessions, including creation, disposal, command execution, and directory uploading, facilitating SSH-based remote execution within a sandbox environment.

methods.name: function normalizeInlineSshMaterial(contents: string, filename: string): string { normalizeInlineSshMaterial
methods.description: Normalizes SSH key material contents by removing BOM, normalizing newlines, and expanding escaped newlines, based on filename context.

methods.name: function buildSshFailureMessage(stderr: string, exitCode?: number): string { buildSshFailureMessage
methods.description: Constructs a user-friendly error message based on SSH command stderr output and exit code.

methods.name: export function shellEscape(value: string): string { shellEscape
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe inclusion in a shell command.

methods.name: buildRemoteCommand
methods.description: Builds a remote shell command string from an array of arguments with proper escaping.

methods.name: buildExecRemoteCommand
methods.description: Generates a shell command string to execute a command with optional working directory and environment variables.

methods.name: buildSshSandboxArgv
methods.description: Constructs the argument vector for the SSH command based on session details and remote command.

methods.name: createSshSandboxSessionFromConfigText
methods.description: Creates an SSH sandbox session using provided SSH config text, saving config to a temporary directory.

methods.name: createSshSandboxSessionFromSettings
methods.description: Sets up an SSH sandbox session based on provided settings, including key and host configuration.

methods.name: disposeSshSandboxSession
methods.description: Removes temporary files associated with a sandbox SSH session.

methods.name: runSshSandboxCommand
methods.description: Executes a command within an SSH sandbox session, capturing output and handling errors.

methods.name: uploadDirectoryToSshTarget
methods.description: Uploads a local directory to a remote SSH target via tar over SSH, with symlink safety checks.

methods.name: assertSafeUploadSymlinks
methods.description: Recursively verifies that symbolic links in the directory do not escape the root directory to prevent malicious uploads.

methods.name: parseSshConfigHost
methods.description: Extracts the hostname from SSH config text.

methods.name: resolveSshTmpRoot
methods.description: Determines the root temporary directory for SSH sandbox operations.

methods.name: resolveOptionalLocalPath
methods.description: Resolves a user path string to an absolute path, or undefined if input is undefined.

methods.name: writeSecretMaterial
methods.description: Writes SSH key material to a file with proper permissions, returning the file path.
